question: How does recognition operate across all aggregates from earth onward?
premises: The analogy extends from a single object to every aggregate beginning with earth.
One can recognize one's own self in relation to these aggregates.
The self then shines forth as full.
inference: By recognizing the self through every aggregate, one experiences the self as inherently full.
plain_english: In the same way, recognizing one's own self through each and every aggregate beginning with earth, one shines forth as truly full.
